Ideally located for exploring Rouen, a city of art, history, and culture. Whether you're traveling for business, visiting family, or on a weekend getaway, our hotel offers all the amenities you need for a successful stay.

Our rooms are designed to guarantee maximum comfort:
- Quality bedding
- Private bathroom with shower
- Free high-speed Wi-Fi
- Flat-screen TV with TNT channels
- Rooms accessible to people with reduced mobility (PMR).
We offer several configurations: double and twin rooms.

Full and delicious buffet breakfast
Every morning between 6:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m., enjoy our all-you-can-eat buffet breakfast, served in a welcoming dining room.
On the menu: pastries, breads, brioche, jams, yogurts, cereals, eggs, ham, bacon, cheeses, hot drinks, and fruit juices.
An ideal way to start your day of work or discovery. 

Arrival and Departure Times
Check-in from 2:00 PM
Check-out until 12:00 PM
For late arrivals, please notify reception.

Secure Private Parking
We provide secure private parking (additional charge).
The rate is €6 per day. To access the parking lot, please go to "Avenue de Bretagne," follow the signs for night access, and park at the letter K.
Public parking is also available nearby.

A Strategic Location in the Heart of Rouen
Located on the banks of the Seine, a few minutes' walk from the historic center of Rouen, our hotel enjoys an ideal central location for discovering the city's cultural and architectural riches.

Close to Museums and Cultural Sites
Rouen is a city with an exceptional heritage. From the hotel, you can easily access the main museums and monuments on foot or by public transport:

Museum of Fine Arts (15-minute walk): one of the richest collections in France, with works by Monet, Delacroix, Modigliani, and Gérard David.

Historial Joan of Arc: a multimedia immersion into the story of the Maid of Orléans, a must-see for history buffs.

Museum of Natural History: ideal for families, one of the oldest museums in France.

Rouen Cathedral (12-minute walk): a masterpiece of Gothic architecture, immortalized by Monet.

Gros-Horloge, Saint-Maclou Church, and Aître Saint-Maclou are all within walking distance.

Close to universities and training centers
The B&B Hôtel Rouen Center is also an excellent choice for students, teachers, researchers, or visiting parents:

University of Rouen Normandy – Pasteur Campus: less than 10 minutes on foot

Faculty of Law, Literature, and Humanities: accessible by bus or on foot

INSA Rouen, NEOMA Business School, CESI, ESIGELEC: easily accessible by public transport or car

CHU Charles Nicolle & University Hospital: less than 15 minutes by public transport

Practical on-site services

Lougne bar available from October 20th
Free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the hotel

Vending machines with snacks and drinks

Pets welcome (surcharge)

Elevator

100% nonsmoking hotel

24-hour reception

Good value for money in the heart of the city

The B&B Hôtel Rouen Center offers you a An excellent compromise between comfort, location, and price. Whether you're on a short or extended stay, you'll appreciate our simple and efficient service, in a warm atmosphere.

Prime Location: Located a four-minute walk from the University of Picardie Jules Verne and about 40 miles from Beauvais–Tillé Airport, the condo hotel is near attractions such as Zénith d'Amiens and Amiens Train Station.

name: Elegant 120m2-Face cathedrale-6 pers-free Parking
description:
Spacious and Modern: Elegant 120m2-Face cathedrale-6 pers-free Parking in Amiens offers a spacious, recently renovated apartment with two bedrooms and a living room. The property features family rooms, ensuring comfort for all guests.

Modern Amenities: Guests enjoy free WiFi, a bar, and streaming services. The apartment includes a fully equipped kitchen with a coffee machine, microwave, and dishwasher. Additional amenities include a washing machine, work desk, and soundproofing.

Prime Location: Located about 14 minutes from Amiens Train Station and around 0.9 miles from The Floating Gardens Park, the apartment provides easy access to local attractions. Nearby points include the Tribunal de Grande Instance of Amiens and Zénith d'Amiens.

Highly Rated by Guests: Guests appreciate the spaciousness, modern amenities, and free on-site private parking, making it a highly rated choice in Amiens.

name: l'esprit d'EMMA
description:
Modern Comforts: l'esprit d'EMMA in Amiens offers a recently renovated apartment with a sun terrace and free WiFi. The property includes a elevator, family rooms, and free on-site private parking.

Convenient Amenities: Guests can enjoy a fully equipped kitchen with a coffee machine, dining table, and outdoor furniture. Additional amenities include a washing machine, private bathroom, and a work desk.

Prime Location: Located 15 minutes from Amiens Train Station and 1312 feet from The Floating Gardens Park, the apartment provides easy access to local attractions. Beauvais–Tillé Airport is 43 mi away.

name: Hôtel Vert
description:
Hotel Vert offers pastel-colored rooms with a private bathroom, TV and free Wi-Fi access. It is located 1.2 mi from the Mont Saint-Michel tidal island on the Normandy Coast.

Guests can enjoy regional cuisine at the Vert’s restaurant, La salicorne. The hotel’s bar, L’Equinoxe, opens onto a private terrace.

The Vert Hotel provides a 24-hour reception and private parking. There is also an on site supermarket and souvenir shop.

name: Le Relais Saint Michel
description:
Le Relais Saint Michel is an hotel facing the bay of Mont Saint-Michel. All guest rooms ( except Twin Room Saint-Michel with interior view) offer a private terrace and some have panoramic views of Mont Saint-Michel.

The soundproofed rooms are comfortable and spacious. They are fully equipped with modern comforts including a mini-bar and free Wi-Fi access. Each room has private bathrooms.

The hotel’s restaurant offers traditional cuisine. Guests can enjoy a drink or a meal on the terrace, which offers views of the Mont St Michel.

A free shuttle service that stops in front of the hotel will take you to the famous landmark Mont St Michel in just 10 minutes. Safety jackets are provided for guests wishing to take a walk at night. For guests arriving by car, secured parking is available with an extra cost.

name: Mercure Mont Saint Michel
description:
This Mercure is located in parkland just 1.2 mi from the abbey of Mont Saint Michel. It offers spacious rooms with attached bathroom, a restaurant and bar and plenty of free on-site parking.

The air-conditioned rooms at Mercure Mont Saint Michel are equipped with facilities for making hot drinks.  A flat-screen TV with satellite and cable channels is also provided.

The restaurant, Le Pré Salé, is famous in the area and serves delicious seafood and regional specialties. The bar, Le Normandy, offers a relaxed setting for a drink among friends.

Mercure Mont Saint Michel is 4 mi from Pontorson and 32 mi from Saint-Malo.

name: Le Saint Aubert
description:
Set amid lush greenery, just 1.2 mi from the Mont Saint-Michel, the hotel welcomes you in a warm and friendly atmosphere.

Hôtel Saint-Aubert features comfortable and very quiet rooms, surrounded by gardens full of flowers.

After a day spent exploring the Mont Saint-Michel, enjoy a delicious regional cuisine in the picturesque setting of a former farmhouse.

The helpful staff will be happy to provide you with information about the visits and the many attractions in the surrounding area.

The check-in is at the reception of Le Relais Saint Michel (last hotel before the bridge leading to the Mont Saint-Michel)

name: La Confiance
description:
Composed of 2 different buildings, Les Terrasses Poulard is a historical property in the heart of Mont Saint-Michel and offers views of the bay, the village and the street.

Accessed by stairs, each room has a modern décor. Some rooms include large windows with bay views. They are equipped with TV and a private bathroom.

Breakfast is served at the restaurant Les Terrasses de la Baie. Once arrived at the restaurant, please go to the first floor.
Alternatively, guests can enjoy a meal at the onsite La Confiance restaurant and offers meals, drinks and snacks.

Guests can enjoy a drink in the Les Terrasses Poulard’s bar. It offers a 24-hour front desk service and guests can leave their luggage at the reception.

Activities in the area include cycling, fishing and hiking and explore the island.

The check-in is at the reception of Le Relais Saint Michel (last hotel before the bridge leading to the Mont Saint-Michel)

name: Hotel De La Digue
description:
Comfortable Accommodations: Hotel De La Digue in Le Mont Saint Michel offers family rooms with private bathrooms, balconies, and river views. Each room includes a bath, shower, TV, and soundproofing.

Essential Facilities: Guests enjoy free WiFi, a 24-hour front desk, daily housekeeping, and an electric vehicle charging station. Additional amenities include bicycle parking, room service, and an outdoor seating area.

Dining Options: A continental and American breakfast is served with juice, fresh pastries, cheese, and fruits.

Local Attractions: Mont Saint Michel Abbey and Mont Saint-Michel are about 4 miles away. Other points of interest include the Scriptorial of Avranches and Champrepus Zoo, each around 25 miles from the hotel. Rennes–Saint-Jacques Airport is about 55 miles distant.

name: Hotel Gabriel
description:
Hotel Gabriel is located 1 mi from Mont Saint-Michel. It offers free Wi-Fi access and rooms with attached bathroom just a 25-minute walk from the walls of the old city.

The hotel has no elevator and has rooms on the ground floor, 1st and 2nd floor for family rooms.  Each room has a TV, kettle and a private bathroom with shower and toilet.

A buffet breakfast is available every morning.

Hotel Gabriel is a 6-minute drive from the E401 motorway. Pontorson TGV Train Station has connections to Paris and is 4.5 mi away.

La Salicorne offers you authentic, vegetable, colorful, festive and eco responsible world cuisine. Le Pré Salé offers you Pré Salé lamb and semi gastronomic french cuisine.

name: La Mère Poulard
description:
Stay in a Historic Hotel at the Heart of Mont Saint-Michel.

Hôtel La Mère Poulard, located in the heart of Mont Saint-Michel, has preserved the authentic charm of traditional inns from the past. For over a century, this iconic establishment has welcomed pilgrims and travelers from around the world in a setting rich in history.

The hotel consists of three historic houses, each offering a unique atmosphere:

The Historic Inn, where the story of La Mère Poulard began.

La Maison Rouge, with its adjoining garden, providing a peaceful setting.

L’Ermitage, also known as Maison d’Annette, the final residence of the famous cook.

The rooms, with their classic style, offer breathtaking views of the bay, the Abbey, or the medieval town. They are equipped with a flat-screen TV, free Wi-Fi, and a private bathroom with a bathtub.

La Mère Poulard’s renowned restaurant invites you to savor its traditional recipes, including the famous omelet, prepared using Annette Poulard’s unique expertize since 1888.

Take advantage of your stay to explore Mont Saint-Michel and its picturesque streets, hike the surrounding trails, or discover the region by bike.

Avranches is a 23-minute drive away, and Saint-Malo is 45 minutes away.

The check-in is at the reception of Le Relais Saint Michel (last hotel before the bridge leading to the Mont Saint-Michel)

name: La Vieille Auberge
description:
La Vieille Auberge is located in the medieval village of Mont-Saint-Michel, a few steps from the famous abbey. It offers free Wi-Fi, a restaurant, a terrace and hotel reception in its main house.

The rooms are divided between two annexes located high up in the village and accessible by numerous steps. One offers standard rooms in the middle of the village, overlooking the street, while the other, at the top of the village, offers rooms with a view of the bay and a terrace. All rooms have flat-screen TVs and private bathrooms with bath or shower.

The hotel also features a bar and a restaurant serving traditional French cuisine.

name: Le Relais Du Roy
description:
Le Relais Du Roy is a 3-star hotel located next to the River Couesnon, just 0.9 mi from the Mont Saint-Michel and 164 feet from the free shuttle bus.

Featuring flat-screen TVs with satellite channels, a telephone and a welcome tray, each guest room at Le Relais Du Roy is decorated in a classic style. They also have a private bathroom with a bath or a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. Some of the rooms feature a balcony.

A buffet breakfast is served each morning at the hotel.

A grocery store can be found within a 3-minute walk from the hotel. The town of Pontorson is 4.3 mi away. Private parking is available with an extra cost.

name: Le Mouton Blanc
description:
At the foot of the abbey, the Mouton Blanc Hotel, welcomes you in its historic 14th century location. Le Mouton Blanc provides comfortable rooms with a simple yet cozy decoration.

The rooms are divided in 3 buildings: one of them offers views of the Mont Saint-Michel, and the other one features medieval-style rooms.

The Mouton Blanc restaurant offers local traditional cuisine, served in the dining room or the terrace. Breakfast is served daily.

Personalized services for visits, recreation and other activities are available upon request.

Please note that the reception of the hotel Le Mouton blanc is currently closed. Please note that arrival arrangements are made at the reception of the hotel Les Terrasses Poulard.

The check-in is at the reception of Le Relais Saint Michel (last hotel before the bridge leading to the Mont Saint-Michel)

name: Hôtel la Croix Blanche
description:
Located in the heart of Mont Saint Michel medieval Village, Hôtel La Croix Blanche will be happy to accommodate you.

The rooms at Hôtel La Croix Blanche are located on the third and fourth floor without elevator and have a flat-screen, satellite TV and a mini-bar. Free Wi-Fi access is provided.

In addition to the visit of Mont-Saint-Michel and its abbey, guests can go to Saint-Malo, 31 mi from the hotel.

name: Auberge Saint Pierre
description:
The Auberge Saint Pierre is made up of small 14th century half-timbered houses located on the island of Mont-Saint-Michel. It combines the period charm of exposed beams with modern comforts, including a TV and free Wi-Fi.

Ideally located for visiting Mont-Saint-Michel, this hotel is on the main street which leads to the Mont-Saint-Michel abbey.

Two annexes of the hotel are located in the middle of the village and are accessible by numerous stairs.

The rooms at Auberge Saint Pierre and the annexes have a private bathroom with a bath or shower. Some rooms offer sea views.

The hotel serves a buffet breakfast daily. Traditional Norman cuisine and fish dishes are served in the authentic restaurant and you can choose to dine on site.

name: Appart Standing - La Coque d'Or - Mont-St-Michel
description:
Modern Comforts: Appart Standing - La Coque d'Or in Mont Saint Michel offers a recently renovated apartment with free WiFi, a kitchenette, and a living room. The property includes a private entrance and a dining area.

Convenient Facilities: Guests benefit from private check-in and check-out services, a shuttle, a coffee shop, family rooms, and luggage storage. Additional amenities include streaming services, a TV, and a walk-in shower.

Prime Location: Located a two-minute walk from Mont Saint Michel Abbey and just steps from Mont Saint-Michel, the apartment provides easy access to local attractions. Nearby points of interest include the Scriptorial of Avranches and Port of Houle. Rennes–Saint-Jacques Airport is about 58 miles away.

name: Chez Adèle, au pied de l'Abbaye
description:
Historic Setting: Chez Adèle, au pied de l'Abbaye in Le Mont Saint Michel offers a vacation home experience within a historic building. Guests enjoy sea views and a terrace, perfect for relaxation.

Comfortable Living: The property features two bedrooms and a bathroom, equipped with a kitchen, dining area, and a sofa. Additional amenities include a hairdryer, coffee machine, and complimentary toiletries.

Prime Location: Located just steps from Mont Saint Michel Abbey and a two-minute walk to Mont Saint-Michel, the vacation home is also close to attractions such as the Scriptorial of Avranches and Port of Houle.

Guest Favorites: Guests appreciate the terrace, scenic location, and convenient setting, making it a preferred choice for relaxation and exploration.

name: Chambres d'Hôtes Farcy "La P'tite Transhumance"
description:
Comfortable Accommodations: Chambres d'Hôtes Farcy "La P'tite Transhumance" in Ardevon offers comfortable rooms with private bathrooms, showers, and wardrobes. Each room includes a private bathroom, shower, and wardrobe, ensuring a pleasant stay.

Facilities and Amenities: Guests can enjoy a shared kitchen and barbecue facilities. Free on-site private parking is available. A continental breakfast is served daily. Reception staff speak English and French.

Local Attractions: Mont Saint Michel Abbey and Mont Saint-Michel are about 5.5 miles away. The Scriptorial of Avranches and Manuscript Museum of Mont Saint-Michel are around 13 miles distant. Rennes–Saint-Jacques Airport is about 53 miles from the property.

name: Auberge de la Baie
description:
Ideally located in the heart of the bay and just minutes from Mont-Saint-Michel, the Auberge de la Baie is a perfect stop for travelers seeking serenity in a peaceful, verdant setting. Its location is so exceptional that couples give it a 9.3/10 rating for a two-person stay.

By staying here, you'll benefit from the proximity of shuttle busses (1.2 mi) and hiking trails such as the GR34 and GR223, as well as the Véloscénie bike route leading to Mont-Saint-Michel, allowing you to discover the site at dawn or dusk, when the magic is truly at its best. This strategic location is what earns it the 9.3/10 rating from couples.

One of the most authentic and fascinating sights near the Auberge de la Baie is the passage of the salt marsh sheep. This is an experience travelers love, as it offers a complete immersion in the pastoral life of the bay.

After a day exploring the abbey's narrow streets, return to the comfort of our rooms:

- Free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TV, and private bathroom with hairdryer.

- Delicious Wake-Up: Enjoy a full buffet breakfast each morning, the perfect way to fuel up before setting off on your bay crossing or your climb to the abbey.

- Easy Access: Free parking is available on-site, allowing you to park your vehicle safely and without additional charges.

For dining near the Auberge de la Baie, you'll find several excellent options, ranging from fine dining to casual or traditional cuisine.

name: Camping Les Pommiers du Mont Saint Michel
description:
Accommodations Features: Camping Les Pommiers du Mont Saint Michel in Beauvoir offers a sun terrace, restaurant, bar, and free on-site private parking. The property includes a minimarket, evening entertainment, waterpark, and children's playground.

Amenities and Services: Guests can enjoy an outdoor seating area, picnic spots, kids' pool, games room, and bike hire. The camping provides entertainment staff, a kids' club, and a coffee shop. Additional amenities include a refrigerator, microwave, electric kettle, and private bathrooms.

Local Attractions: Mont Saint Michel Abbey and Mont Saint-Michel are 5 mi away. The Scriptorial of Avranches and Champrepus Zoo are 30 mi from the property. Rennes–Saint-Jacques Airport is 55 mi distant.

name: Hotel Rose
description:
Composed of thoughtfully designed independent bungalows and guestrooms in the annex house of a 19th-century building, Hotel Rose offers comfortable accommodations and a peaceful atmosphere.

The residence is set in a verdant park full of trees and flowers. Some of the accommodations opens out onto the river that leads to the famous Mont Saint Michel and offer a tranquil, relaxing living space. All of the bungalows are independently ecological and can accommodate 4 people (or 5 on request).

Enjoy a tasty breakfast, a casual drink or a relaxing moment on the manor's veranda or under the shade of the trees.

Hotel Rose also features a shared living area with a piano, free Wi-Fi access, games and plenty of reading material. Nearby you can take quiet walks or bike rides and enjoy traditional and regional cuisine in one of the local restaurants.

name: Résidence Beauvoir le Mont-Saint-Michel
description:
Located 2.7 mi from Mont Saint Michel Abbey, Résidence Beauvoir le Mont-Saint-Michel offers self-catered holiday homes with access to a terrace, as well as a tennis court and a BBQ facilities. Free WiFi is offered.

The units provide views of the garden and come with a seating area, a washing machine, a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher, and a private bathroom with a hair dryer. An oven and coffee machine are also available.

At the holiday homes guests are welcome to take advantage of an indoor swimming pool.

A garden and a children's playground are provided at the property.

The nearest airport is Dinard Bretagne Airport, 34 mi from the property.
